//devEngines: The version development and CI actually use, as opposed to the minimum `engines` will tolerate. `pnpm/setup` reads it, so the CI workflows name no Node version of their own. 24 rather than 22: Node 22 moved from Active to Maintenance LTS on 2025-10-21, where it only receives security fixes, while 24 has been Active LTS since 2025-10-28 — the better default for a project just starting out. Vite 8 / Rolldown's own `engines.node` (`^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0`, checked directly in their package.json) is an open-ended `>=`, not capped at the 22.x line, so this move needed no compatibility check beyond that one already-satisfied floor.

scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run arch && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
